blast_optimize_target_frequencies(x:&mut[f64],alphsize:usize,iteration_count:&mut i32,q:&[f64],row_probs:&[f64],col_probs:&[f64],constrain_rel_entropy:bool,desired_re:f64,tolerance:f64,max_iterations:i32)->i32 exactly matches the requested public API. x/q are flat row-major matrices with alphsize² entries.

nlm_add_vectors(y:&mut[f64],n:usize,alpha:f64,x:&[f64]) is exposed for seg_translation composition orchestration. Mutable/immutable slices require nonoverlapping borrows; use split slices for different rows of a shared matrix.
